name: watch
description: Execute a program periodically, showing output fullscreen

name: -b
--beep
options.description: Beep if command has a non-zero exit

name: -c
--color
options.description: Interpret ANSI color and style sequences

name: -C
--no-color
options.description: Do not interpret ANSI color and style sequences

name: -e
--errexit
options.description: Exit if command has a non-zero exit

name: -g
--chgexit
options.description: Exit when output from command changes

name: -q
--equexit
options.description: Exit when output from command does not change

name: -p
--precise
options.description: Attempt run command in precise intervals

name: -r
--no-rerun
options.description: Do not rerun program on window resize

name: -x
--exec
options.description: Pass command to exec instead of "sh -c"
